decisions.question: Math symbols in SVG <text> labels (photon, ionization limit, apparent longitude)
decisions.choice: Typeset with KaTeX in an HTML layer pinned over the SVG (createSvgMathOverlay); unit words such as deg stay as SVG text
decisions.why: SVG text cannot host KaTeX, and the ASCII stand-ins (inf, lambda_app) read as code to an ASTR 101 student. Landed in 6eceb79.

decisions.question: eos-lab stage height on short windows
decisions.choice: Raise the stage-height floor from 380px to 640px
decisions.why: At 1280x720 the 468px budget squashed the plots to 120-204px and put the solar-profile toggle under the stage summary; 640px leaves a 25px gap and 149-273px plots. Readouts need a scroll below a ~900px-tall window. Landed in 6eceb79.

decisions.question: Where the remediation tracker lives
decisions.choice: In the repo, docs/tracker/state.json; the claude.ai page displays it and has no edit buttons
decisions.why: One copy that Codex and every account can read, with git history. The in-browser edit buttons had never been used: all 46 records were still at version 1.

decisions.question: Demos rendered in whatever sans the machine had (Inter on Anna's Mac, a wide fallback on CI), so a dock that fit locally overflowed CI by 15px
decisions.choice: Load the design fonts in every demo AND rework the conservation-laws dock
decisions.why: The font fix makes layouts match across machines; the dock fix keeps a 67px margin even in a wide fallback font (0.06em letter-spacing stress test, calibrated to CI's 914.7px). Landed in commit "Load the design fonts in demos and fix the CI layout overflow".

decisions.question: Shorter label for the conservation-laws direction slider
decisions.why: Keeps the sign convention visible in the label; the accessible name, Angle from tangent, positive is outward, still contains the visible words (WCAG 2.5.3). Landed in commit "Load the design fonts in demos and fix the CI layout overflow".

decisions.question: Shelf tabs under the sticky sidebar (13 tabs in 5 demos at 1280x720)
decisions.choice: Pad the tab rows clear of the sidebar now; the structural fix is a separate task
decisions.why: Same stopgap the accordion bodies already use; shelf-reach.spec.ts holds the line until the overlap itself is removed. Landed in commit "Load the design fonts in demos and fix the CI layout overflow". Superseded by d-shelf-column: the padding is deleted.

decisions.question: eos-lab channel-card numbers grew 21% when S2 moved them to KaTeX, pushing Total P 5px below the fold at 1440x900
decisions.choice: KaTeX at 1em in the cards plus a 15rem readout reserve
decisions.why: Restores the size the mono text had; at 900px tall the 640px stage floor binds and Total P ends at 891px. Landed in commit "Load the design fonts in demos and fix the CI layout overflow".

decisions.question: Explore time label for demos of 10 minutes or less
decisions.why: Keeps the old <= 10 bucket in words. "Under 10 min" had mislabelled angular-size, conservation-laws, em-spectrum and telescope-resolution, which take exactly 10 minutes. Landed in commit 'Label 10-minute demos "Up to 10 min" and record the audit recheck'.

decisions.question: Structural fix for the sticky sidebar sliding over the full-width shelf
decisions.choice: The sidebar owns its whole column, shelf row included (CSS only); the shelf sits beside it
decisions.why: Smallest change: shell template plus the blackbody, hydrostatic and stars-zams-hr overrides, no markup. The sidebar stays pinned while the reader works through shelf activities, which the 2026-09-04 layering note says matters. Measured on eclipse-geometry at 1440x900: overlap 360px wide -> 0, page height unchanged at 1211px. The rejected wrapper option would have let the sidebar scroll away and taken the shelf to 1392px wide, touching ~20 index.html files. Landed in a32087b, merged into main 2026-10-23 (Anna approved both by popup in that session).

decisions.question: Hydrostatic student mode stacks a full-width sticky controls panel above the stage, which pinned over it while scrolling
decisions.choice: Make the controls non-sticky in student mode only, in the same commit
decisions.why: Measured 2026-10-23 at 1440x900, scrolled 500px: the 645px panel covered the top 480px of the stage. Found by the new sidebar-footprint E2E. Landed in a32087b, merged into main 2026-10-23 (Anna approved both by popup in that session).
